concepts.name: Choosing and deciding
concepts.why: All nine readers: the name is Acts 15:28's words ('the Holy Spirit and to us'), but only that one of the six passages says the Spirit shares in the decision. Deut 1:13, Acts 1:26 (the lot) and Acts 6:5 say nothing of the Spirit, and Acts 15:22 speaks of choosing men, not of the decree 15:28 reports. A name one passage says and the others do not must be renamed or the passage moved. A plain label keeps all six passages and quotes Acts 15:28 in its note, so the title no longer implies the Spirit is named in every choosing (readers who hold the lot, the whole church, or the apostles and elders as the pattern all part here).

secondary_or_links: No change. All 15 links are grounded in passages now in the outline: Covenant (Exod 19:5-6, Mal 2:10), Priesthood (concept 11), Temple/Presence (concept 12), Spirit (concepts 16-17), Children of God (concept 18, Heb 2:11, Mal 2:10), Kingdom (Luke 12:32, Matt 16:19, Rev 1:6), Messiah/Christology (concepts 13, 15, 20), Deliverance/Salvation (concept 5, Joel 2:32), New Creation (Rev 21:2), Blessing & Commission (Matt 28:19-20, John 20:21, Acts 1:8), Law/Wisdom (Lev 19, Deut 15:7, Rom 13:8), Judgment (1 Pet 4:17, 1 Cor 5:13), Mercy & Restoration (1 Pet 2:10, Gal 6:1, Matt 18:21-22), Father, Son and Holy Spirit (Matt 28:19, 2 Cor 13:14), Apocalyptic (Rev 1:20, 7:9, 19:7-8). Secondary concepts are quotations and fine. Every note in the 52 concepts was checked against its verse and is exact. The closing concept 52 is the theme's own words of hope, from within the theme, with the dark concepts (divisions, persecution, warnings to the churches) left standing before it.
